_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

individual_name.label: Individual Name
individual_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_contact.label: Petitioner Contact
petitioner_contact.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest.label: Petitioner Interest
petitioner_interest.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest_other.label: Petitioner Interest Other
petitioner_interest_other.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

subject_contact.label: Subject Contact
subject_contact.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

subject_location.label: Subject Location
subject_location.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

subject_return_date.label: Subject Return Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

notify_person_1.label: Notify Person 1
notify_person_1.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notify_person_2.label: Notify Person 2
notify_person_2.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notify_person_3.label: Notify Person 3
notify_person_3.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notify_person_4.label: Notify Person 4
notify_person_4.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notify_person_5.label: Notify Person 5
notify_person_5.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notify_person_6.label: Notify Person 6
notify_person_6.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

hearing_request.label: Hearing Request
hearing_request.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required
